provenance: Pixel-authored production asset: deterministic code-native integer primitives at native 16 x 16 cell resolution under explicit per-family palettes. No image generator, traced reference, or external pixels.

alphaPolicy.shadowRule: one fixed ink shadow value, written only onto otherwise transparent pixels

restrictions: Presentation only: prop pixels never define collision, exits, hazards, movement, or interactions; authored level data stays authoritative.
Dressing only covers authored impassable cells and never covers walkable cells, exits, spawn points, or interactable positions.
No text, glyphs, or readable documents are baked into any frame; notice boards and ledgers show blank sheets only.
Do not depict sacred objects as loot or trophies; stone lanterns and fire-watch bells are secular roadside and village fixtures.
No real insignia, crests, heraldry, or authentic shogunal or imperial emblems; castle trim is invented lacquer and vermilion geometry.
No image generator, traced reference, or external pixels; every frame is drawn by deterministic integer primitives in this builder.
Wrong-size or failed images keep the existing flat wall fallback; external Japanese cultural review is still pending before art lock.
